_comment: Grok Bot Companion roster. The relay re-reads this file when it changes (no restart). Order = carousel order.
avatar.shape and avatar.color mirror each bot's app profile (avatarShape / avatarColor).
shape: blob | teardrop | cloud | hex | squircle | circle (circle = neutral default for bots with no app shape).
color: a name from 'palette' below, or a literal #RRGGBB. Tune the hex values in 'palette' once we have app screenshots; every bot using that color follows.

Optional avatar tweaks: accent / rim (#RRGGBB or palette name), scale (body % of the 466 px screen, default 86), rotation (deg), wobble (blob/cloud organic amount 0-100, default 50), seed (0-255, varies blob outline).
tbd: true = the app has no shape/color for this bot yet; the device shows the neutral default. Replace once a screenshot arrives.
default_voice_id: an id from voices.json (the app voice). Clay = cosmo (his app setting); bots with no app voice use eve (xAI default).

palette._comment: Approximate until checked against app screenshots. rim = optional outline (used for dark bodies on the black AMOLED).
